methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 sous vide immersion circulators that were high-search or commercially notable as of 2023-2026. Each entry was independently re-verified against official brand product pages (anovaculinary.com, inkbird.com, shop.greatergoods.com, instantpot.com, breville.com, typhur.com, us.vesync.com) plus retailer and review listings (Amazon, Zoro, ManualsLib, Reviewed.com, culinaryreviewer.com, amazingfoodmadeeasy.com, topsousvide.com). Wattage and max temperature are manufacturer-stated; pump_flow_lph is liters/hour converted from manufacturer L/min or GPM where needed; priceUsd reflects published US MSRP or current list price; connectivity is recorded as wifi/bluetooth/wifi+bluetooth/none; ip_water_rating is the published IPX designation, null where not published; max_water_capacity_l is the manufacturer-stated maximum water bath volume. Corrections this pass: Instant Pot Accu Slim V2 max_temp_f 195->203 (195F belongs to the older SSV800; the V2 product linked here is rated 68-203F per Instant Pot V2 listing and multiple reviews). Anova Nano 3.0 retained at 850W per the official anovaculinary.com spec (Amazon listing title's 800W is a known retailer error). Greater Goods max_water_capacity_l left null because the official Greater Goods product page does not publish a bath-volume figure. All accessedAt 2026-06-19.
